regressions.title: Held finding F-04's remedy (placed_text coverage) shipped under F-02 and flipped two existing test expectations
regressions.evidence: src/pipeline/claim_coverage.py:56-64 and :78-86 gain `placed_text`, src/pipeline/narrative.py:33 forwards it, and server.py:972-975 passes step-placed narration. Consequence pinned by the diff: tests/pipeline/test_server.py:1439 `md.count("[verify]") == 0` (was 3) and tests/pipeline/test_webui_pages.py:406 'Verify claims' yellow (was green). PLAN.json's F-02 approach does name placed_text, so it is planned, but F-04 itself is recorded as held for the user. The CLAUDE.md invariant still holds (every claim is either placed verbatim under a step or [verify]-flagged).

regressions.title: Photo mode: when the semantic rescue fires with mixed captions, captioned steps show the verbatim slice while uncaptioned steps show the polished slice
regressions.evidence: _generate_photo runs _run_semantic_pipeline with polish=any(c is None for c in captions) and raw_out=verbatim (:1121-1122). Captioned steps render verbatim.get(step.id) as narration (:1134); steps whose caption is None take the polished per_step slice as their text (:1130). One doc can thus show the same transcript in two wordings. Low severity; only when a caption fails and the rescue succeeds. 102b0af fixed the all-captioned case (polish now skipped), the mixed case remains.

regressions.title: Post-polish narrative coverage check can reject a narrative rewrite for a claim that is also placed verbatim under its step
regressions.evidence: `owned = [c for c in claims if validate_claim_coverage(narrative_text or "", [c])[0]]` keeps a claim covered by the pre-polish narrative even when placed_text also covers it; if narrative polish paraphrases that claim, :1407-1410 discards the whole narrative rewrite and records polish_rejected_claim_coverage although the claim is still rendered verbatim under its step. Conservative false positive, polish is off by default, no test covers paraphrase + placed transcript + polish enabled.
